integrity: Analytic proof supplies all dimensions and exponents; code illustrates finite cases. Same-model review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only second Gelfand width for real-linear self-adjoint matrices and operator-norm target; no higher index. Finite diagnostic is not proof. Prior algebraic-eigenvalue literature may conceal an implicit generalization.
title: The unique optimal Schatten hyperplane of self-adjoint matrices and its rank phase transition
